Container.Name: clip-bot
Container.Overview: Watches a folder of exported gaming clips, crops them to vertical 1080x1920 Shorts, titles them from the filename and uploads them to YouTube. Web UI for settings, the clip queue and YouTube sign-in.

Config.Name: Clips folder
Config.Description: The share SteelSeries Moments clips are exported to. Read-only: the bot never changes your originals.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Settings, queue database, YouTube sign-in and rendered Shorts.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: LAN only. Don't port-forward it; it has no login.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id files are written as (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id files are written as (100 = users).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For timestamps in the web UI and logs.
